narratives.author: claude
narratives.headline: Thin morning: five Pass-grade props, Barrett's absence the main storyline, and no injury reports final yet
narratives.briefing: It is a full 11-game slate with every game still to tip, but the board is thin: all five props carry Pass-level conviction (33 to 34), so nothing here clears the bar for a confident play. The clearest case is Allen Graves Under 10.5, where the projection (8.7), the simulation (63%) and his recent form (under in 8 of his last 10) agree, though RJ Barrett being out pushes more of the offense his way. The report's own record argues for caution: the morning edition is 16-27-0 (-12.28u), and game lines are 23-48 (-27.38u) since 2026-11-11, though morning picks have seen the closing line move toward them 30 times against 11. We are still waiting on official injury reports for OG Anunoby (Doubtful), Joel Embiid, Austin Reaves, LaMelo Ball, De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper and Kelly Oubre Jr. (all Questionable), plus Giannis Antetokounmpo (Probable). Embiid's status matters most for the PHI -3.5 lean, and Fox and Harper for the LAL @ SA total.

cards.p|4395724|pts|Under: Quickley's projection of 17.1 sits under 18.5, he stayed under in 7 of his last 10, and the line has already dropped from 19.5 to 18.5. What makes you wrong is Barrett being out: his usage goes from 19% to 25% without him and his points are up 7% tonight, and the misses came on heavier shot volume (15.6 shots vs 11.9). Model, sim and market all sit near 50%, so this is close to a coin flip.
cards.p|4397424|tpm|Over: This is a long-shot price (+690) on one made three, backed by secure minutes and a +6% home split. The case against it is stronger: the simulation has only 23% of games going over, he went over in only 3 of his last 10 and in 0 of 5 against ATL. Treat it as a lottery ticket at most.
cards.p|4431736|pts|Under: Camara is averaging 9.4 points over his last 10 against an 11.5 line and has gone under in 5 of 7 against GS. The simulation disagrees, with only 46% of games going under, and the −127 price leaves little room since the play-to stops at −121. Ja Morant remains out for POR, which keeps the shot distribution as it has been.
cards.p|5149115|pts|Under: The strongest agreement on the board: projection 8.7, sim 63% under, average of 6.5 over his last 10, and under even 8.5 in 7 of his last 10. The risk is minutes and role: he is projected for 26.9 minutes, and his overs came when he played long (23.7 minutes), while Barrett's absence lifts his usage by +180%. If the Raptors lean on him the way recent reports describe, this can go over.
cards.p|4065648|pts|Under: Tatum's projection of 27.4 is right on the 27.5 line, and he stayed under in 7 of his last 10. ATL is a soft matchup for small forwards (#5 softest of 30, +5% points), and the simulation has only 47% of games going under. Treat this as a thin edge that could disappear if the price moves past −107.

narratives.briefing: Since the morning edition the market has taken most of the board away: Quickley, Queta's threes, Camara and Tatum were all removed as their lines moved (Tatum to 26.5, Camara to 10.5, Quickley back to 18.5). Allen Graves Under 10.5 is the only morning pick still Holding, now at −115 after opening at −128, though that price sits past the −110 play-to. The four props added since (Santos, Gafford, Ingram, George) are Pass-grade at conviction 33 and all Past play-to, so none is worth adding at the current number. Injury news moved the totals: Damian Lillard was ruled out, OG Anunoby went to out (MIA @ NY Over 222.5 is a new lean) and LaMelo Ball went to out (MEM @ MIN Over 219.5 is back). The record argues for caution, with the morning edition at 16-27-0 (-12.28u); before tip we are waiting on Embiid, Oubre, Kyrie Irving, Mo Bamba, Reaves, Fox and Harper.

cards.p|5149115|pts|Under: Still the board's best agreement: projection 8.7 against 10.5, the sim has the under in 63% of games, he stayed under in 8 of his last 10, and Kalshi (56%) is warmer on it than DraftKings (50%). What makes you wrong is role: with Barrett out his usage is up +180%, and his overs came when he played long (23.7 minutes) while he is projected for 26.9 tonight. At −115 the price is already past the −110 play-to, so it is a hold rather than a fresh add.
cards.p|4997536|pts|Under: Santos is averaging 7.8 points over his last 10 against a 9.5 line and went under in 6 of 6 against POR, and the sim has the under at 56%. The risk is opportunity: his usage is up +152% without Curry, and with Lillard ruled out the game may open up. At −125 it is past the −119 play-to, so do not add at this number.
cards.p|4278049|pts|Under: The projection (9.6) and his 8.8 average both sit under 10.5, he stayed under in 8 of his last 10, and PHX is the #4 toughest matchup for power forwards. Against it: only 2 of 5 under against PHX, the line already moved up from 9.5, and Kyrie Irving's questionable tag means the model will re-price on the next run. At −120 it is past the −115 play-to.
cards.p|3913176|pts|Under: The model projects 16.7 against 18.5 and the sim has the under at 57%, with Vegas's team total 4 below the model's. Kalshi is cooler (50%) than DraftKings (53%), and at home he has gone under only 8 of 20; his overs came in long minutes (34.3) while he is projected for 27.8. At −127 it is past the −121 play-to.
cards.p|4433627|pts|Under: George stayed under 20.5 in 7 of his last 10, the sim has the under at 55%, and blowout risk is high at 47% of sims ending 15+ apart. The miss case is volume and minutes: 18.4 shots and 36 minutes in the overs against a 32.2-minute projection, with Markkanen out and Mo Bamba questionable. At −114 it is past the −108 play-to.

narratives.headline: Final: no prop is clean at its play-to price; the board leans on game totals and late news on Embiid, Irving and Robinson
narratives.briefing: Eleven-game holiday slate with nothing tipped yet, and the props board thinned out all day: most of this morning's and midday's unders were pulled as the lines moved to 'no longer +EV at tonight's line'. Of the five props still listed, four (Allen Graves, Jalen Johnson, Gui Santos, Daniel Gafford) are marked past play-to, and the fifth, Neemias Queta Under 11.5, is listed at −110 against a play-to of −105, so none can be added at its own number tonight. All five are Pass-tier at conviction 33 or 34. The game-line leans still holding are DAL @ PHX Over 225.5, MEM @ MIN Over 220.5 and an upgraded PHI @ IND Over 227.5; BKN +9.5 and GS @ POR Over 216.5 are past play-to. The record argues for restraint: final picks are 20-25-0 (-5.69u), morning picks 16-27-0 (-12.28u), and game lines 23-48 (-27.38u) since 2026-11-11, though closing-line moves on morning picks ran 30 toward and 11 against. Still open before tip: Joel Embiid (illness, questionable), Kyrie Irving (knee management, questionable) and Mitchell Robinson in Boston (illness, questionable), whose status decides Queta's minutes.

cards.p|4397424|pts|Under: The only prop listed as New: the line moved his way from 12.5 to 11.5, and he stayed under 11.5 in 4 of 5 against ATL. The risk is minutes: he misses when he plays long, he is projected for 25.4, and with Mitchell Robinson questionable he is expected to keep starting. At −110 it is already past the −105 play-to.
cards.p|5149115|pts|Under: The case is form, not price: averaging 6.5 over his last 10 and under 9.5 in 8 of 10. But the line dropped from 10.5 to 9.5 and −108 is past the −103 play-to; with RJ Barrett out his usage jumps, and long minutes (projected 27.3) are what beat this under. Hold, don't add.
cards.p|4701230|pts|Under: BOS is the #2 toughest defense on power forwards and the sim has him under in 57%. CJ McCollum is out, which pushes his usage up, and −123 is past the −118 play-to.
cards.p|4997536|pts|Under: Under 9.5 in 6 of 6 against POR, but Stephen Curry is out and his usage rises sharply without him; Damian Lillard is also out for Portland. At −128 it is past the −122 play-to.
cards.p|4278049|pts|Under: Under 10.5 in 8 of his last 10 and PHX is #4 toughest on the position, but he went over in 3 of 5 against PHX and −127 is past the −121 play-to. Kyrie Irving is questionable; the model re-prices on the next run if that changes.

narratives.leans_note: Leans only, never best bets: PHI @ IND Over 227.5 was upgraded after Dean Wade was ruled out, but Jaylen Brown is out and Embiid is questionable for Philadelphia, so that total depends on news still pending.
